title: Paper chromatography
caption: Spots of a food colouring and three known dyes are placed on a pencil baseline above the solvent. As the solvent rises it carries each dye a characteristic distance. The colouring contains dyes A and B (same Rf), but not C. Rf = distance moved by the spot ÷ distance moved by the solvent.
alt: A paper chromatogram: the mixture lane has three spots; lanes A, B and C have one spot each; A and B match two of the mixture's spots.
description: Dye A: one spot at 0.32. Dye B: 0.61. Dye C: 0.45, matching nothing in the mixture.
Rf for the B spot: 4.88 cm ÷ 8.0 cm = 0.61.
